name: mcp-trust-check
description: CLI that detects MCP tool poisoning and rug pulls: baseline + diff + LLM review

scripts.test: tsx --test tests/validate.test.ts tests/canonicalize.test.ts tests/diff.test.ts tests/baseline.test.ts tests/cli.test.ts tests/reviewer.test.ts tests/review-runner.test.ts tests/eval-cases.test.ts
scripts.demo:rug-pull:approve: tsx --env-file=.env src/cli.ts approve -- npx tsx src/dummy-server-rug-pull.ts
scripts.demo:rug-pull:check: tsx --env-file=.env src/cli.ts check -- npx tsx src/dummy-server-rug-pull.ts
scripts.demo:rug-pull:approve:accept: tsx --env-file=.env src/cli.ts approve --accept -- npx tsx src/dummy-server-rug-pull.ts
